# Tool reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-docs.mjs from packages/protocol/src/index.ts. Do not edit; run `npm run docs:gen`. -->

Every tool below is one registry entry (D13). On the MCP wire dots become underscores
(`nav.goto` → `nav_goto`); REST is `POST /v1/call/<name>` and the CLI is `tabagent <name> --json '{…}'`.
Levels are the site-policy level the tool needs (`deny < read < act < full`, D16; `none` = not site-scoped).
Sensitive categories are the D18 gates: **a** submits a form with password, card or SSN-like fields; **b** click matching purchase/delete/send/transfer (best-effort); **c** runs arbitrary page JavaScript; **d** reads credentials (cookies, storage, network); **e** transfers a local file; **f** adopts a user tab (always asks).
Page-derived result fields are wrapped as untrusted page data at the bridge output edge (D21).

## auth

### auth.status

Sign-in options for the tab's site: login form present, matching saved accounts (masked), code sources. Fetches no secrets.

MCP name `auth_status` · level read · profiles auth · lite supported · handled by both

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer |  | Tab id; default: the session's active tab |

### auth.login

Sign in: fill username/password from a saved account for this site (asks you), optionally submit. Never returns the secret.

MCP name `auth_login` · level act · profiles auth · lite unsupported · handled by both

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer |  | Tab id; default: the session's active tab |
| `account` | string |  | Account id from auth.status when several match |
| `submit` | boolean |  | Default true |

### auth.code

Fetch a one-time code (totp, email, sms; auto tries in that order) and type it into the code field. Never returns the code.

MCP name `auth_code` · level act · profiles auth · lite unsupported · handled by both

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer |  | Tab id; default: the session's active tab |
| `ref` | string |  | Code field ref; default: the detected one-time-code field |
| `source` | "auto" \| "totp" \| "email" \| "sms" |  | Default auto |
| `from` | string |  | Sender domain filter for email codes |
| `timeout` | integer |  | ms to wait for the code, default 60000 |
| `submit` | boolean |  | Default true |

### auth.handoff

Hand the tab to the user for a human-only step (passkey, CAPTCHA, ID check, phone approval); waits for Done (5 min; 30 with remote handoff on).

MCP name `auth_handoff` · level read · profiles auth · lite supported · handled by extension

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer |  | Tab id; default: the session's active tab |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |

### captcha.solve

Solve the CAPTCHA on the page (hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA, Turnstile): checkbox click first, then the bridge's solver. Never returns the token.

MCP name `captcha_solve` · level act · profiles auth · lite unsupported · handled by both

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer |  | Tab id; default: the session's active tab |
| `ref` | string |  | Widget ref when the page has several |
